manager_audit.recipient_activation: The checkpoint-2 and checkpoint-3 treatment workers each received exactly one latest manager artifact.

score_blinding.detail: Manager requests contained no numeric external pass counts, hidden-test outcomes, pytest collection totals, test hashes, or evaluation result objects. Generic benchmark vocabulary such as Core was not an outcome disclosure.

control_resource_validity.detail: The no-transfer checkpoint-3 trajectory reached the exact 32-action boundary without issuing COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT.

integrity.detail: No infrastructure, model-query, target-drift, or prohibited-access failure was observed.

growing_divergence.detail: The gaps remained positive rather than becoming increasingly negative.

complexity_support.detail: The recursive arm received a larger prompt at each model call, but it completed in half as many actions and used fewer cumulative input tokens. The boundary event occurred only in no transfer.

decision.reason: The preregistered replication trigger required negative treatment-control all-test gaps at both checkpoints 2 and 3; both observed gaps were positive.
decision.pair_disposition: Stop the Kimi-K2.6 MaaS plus execution_server CP1-to-CP3 pair. Do not add replications or retune the action budget after seeing outcomes.
decision.formal_claim: No confirmatory treatment effect is estimable because the no-transfer terminal trajectory failed the frozen explicit-completion gate.
decision.descriptive_direction: Under the matched fixed budget, recursive self-report MOA synthesis improved all-test and Core scores at checkpoints 2 and 3, completed checkpoint 3 in 16 rather than 32 actions, and used fewer cumulative tokens.
decision.iteration_hypothesis: This run does not support the claim that the missing degradation curve was caused only by too few feedback iterations. Two recursive updates increased manager-state size but did not degrade the treatment arm. The unused later checkpoints cannot be used to rescue the hypothesis because checkpoint 4 was already boundary-censored under no transfer during provider-specific calibration.

paper_use.allowed: Report as a preregistered negative/invalid pilot showing that modest recursive playbook growth can improve efficiency and quality, while the harder no-transfer terminal task became budget-censored.
paper_use.not_allowed: Do not claim that recursive experience prevents degradation in general, that iteration count has been conclusively ruled out, or that the treatment has a statistically reliable positive effect from one worker per arm.
